# The Instagram Growth Machine (10 easy steps) (AutomateWithAI)

> A $10 beginner PDF course teaching AI automation with free, no-code tools: faceless Instagram AI content pipelines, Gmail automation, Zapier and Make workflows, Instagram DM auto-replies, and a 7-day action plan. No income claims.

## Key facts
- Price: $10 USD, one-time, instant PDF download (~25 pages)
- Level: beginner, no coding
- Tools covered: ChatGPT/Gemini, MoneyPrinterTurbo, CapCut, Pexels/Pixabay, Meta Business Suite, Gmail, Google Forms/Sheets, Zapier, Make, Instagram saved replies
- Creator: AutomateWithAI, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/theautomatewith.ai/

- [Run AI on your own device](https://byash93-cell.github.io/theautomatewithai/run-ai-on-your-own-device-muse-spark-open/): Muse Spark Open facts and hardware, Ollama, local options
- [Free ChatGPT for meeting notes and captions](https://byash93-cell.github.io/theautomatewithai/free-chatgpt-meeting-notes-task-table-captions/): copy-paste prompts for task tables, replies, captions

- [Automate Instagram posting for free](https://byash93-cell.github.io/theautomatewithai/automate-instagram-posting-free-meta-business-suite/): schedule reels with Meta Business Suite or the Instagram app, verified scheduling windows
